local function words(s)
    local list = {}
    for word in s:gmatch("[^ ]+") do
        list[#list + 1] = word
    end
    return list
end
local function keys(t)
    local list = {}
    for key in pairs(t) do
        list[#list + 1] = key
    end
    table.sort(list)
    return list
end
local function copy(t)
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        result[k] = v
    end
    return result
end
local function notation(r)
    return string.format("(%d,%d)-(%d,%d)", r.x1, r.y1, r.x2, r.y2)
end
local function point(x, y)
    return string.format("(%d,%d)", x, y)
end
local function area(r)
    return (r.x2 - r.x1) * (r.y2 - r.y1)
end
local function encloses(a, b)
    return a.x1 <= b.x1 and a.y1 <= b.y1 and a.x2 >= b.x2 and a.y2 >= b.y2
end
local function compare(a, b)
    local r = {
        x1 = math.max(a.x1, b.x1),
        y1 = math.max(a.y1, b.y1),
        x2 = math.min(a.x2, b.x2),
        y2 = math.min(a.y2, b.y2)
    }
    r.ox, r.oy = r.x2 - r.x1, r.y2 - r.y1
    r.gap = math.max(0, -r.ox, -r.oy)
    if r.ox > 0 and r.oy > 0 then
        r.kind = "overlap"
    elseif r.ox == 0 and r.oy == 0 then
        r.kind = "corner"
    elseif r.ox >= 0 and r.oy >= 0 then
        r.kind = "edge"
    else
        r.kind = "separate"
        r.direction = r.ox < 0 and r.oy < 0 and "diagonal" or r.ox < 0 and "x" or "y"
    end
    return r
end
local function connected(a, b)
    local r = compare(a, b)
    return a.layer == b.layer and (r.kind == "overlap" or r.kind == "edge")
end
local function margins(a, b)
    return {b.x1 - a.x1, b.y1 - a.y1, a.x2 - b.x2, a.y2 - b.y2}
end
local function minimum(list)
    local value = list[1]
    for _, n in ipairs(list) do
        value = math.min(value, n)
    end
    return value
end
local function decimal(numerator, denominator)
    local h = numerator * 100 // denominator
    return string.format("%d.%02d", h // 100, h % 100)
end
local function bounds(list)
    local r = copy(list[1])
    for _, q in ipairs(list) do
        r.x1, r.y1, r.x2, r.y2 =
            math.min(r.x1, q.x1),
            math.min(r.y1, q.y1),
            math.max(r.x2, q.x2),
            math.max(r.y2, q.y2)
    end
    return r
end
local function distinct(list)
    table.sort(list)
    local result = {}
    for _, n in ipairs(list) do
        if n ~= result[#result] then
            result[#result + 1] = n
        end
    end
    return result
end
local Grid = {}
Grid.__index = Grid
local function makeGrid(list)
    local g = setmetatable({xs = {}, ys = {}, counts = {}}, Grid)
    for _, r in ipairs(list) do
        g.xs[#g.xs + 1], g.xs[#g.xs + 2] = r.x1, r.x2
        g.ys[#g.ys + 1], g.ys[#g.ys + 2] = r.y1, r.y2
    end
    g.xs, g.ys = distinct(g.xs), distinct(g.ys)
    if #list == 0 then
        return g
    end
    local xi, yi, diff = {}, {}, {}
    for i, x in ipairs(g.xs) do
        xi[x] = i
    end
    for i, y in ipairs(g.ys) do
        yi[y] = i
        diff[i] = {}
        for x = 1, #g.xs do
            diff[i][x] = 0
        end
    end
    for _, r in ipairs(list) do
        local a, b, c, d = xi[r.x1], yi[r.y1], xi[r.x2], yi[r.y2]
        diff[b][a], diff[b][c], diff[d][a], diff[d][c] =
            diff[b][a] + 1,
            diff[b][c] - 1,
            diff[d][a] - 1,
            diff[d][c] + 1
    end
    for y = 1, #g.ys do
        for x = 1, #g.xs do
            diff[y][x] =
                diff[y][x] + (y > 1 and diff[y - 1][x] or 0) + (x > 1 and diff[y][x - 1] or 0) -
                (x > 1 and y > 1 and diff[y - 1][x - 1] or 0)
        end
        if y < #g.ys then
            g.counts[y] = {}
            for x = 1, #g.xs - 1 do
                g.counts[y][x] = diff[y][x]
            end
        end
    end
    return g
end
function Grid:covered(k, window)
    local total = 0
    for y, row in ipairs(self.counts) do
        for x, count in ipairs(row) do
            if count >= k then
                local r = {
                    x1 = self.xs[x],
                    y1 = self.ys[y],
                    x2 = self.xs[x + 1],
                    y2 = self.ys[y + 1]
                }
                if window then
                    r = compare(r, window)
                end
                if r.x1 < r.x2 and r.y1 < r.y2 then
                    total = total + area(r)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return total
end
function Grid:perimeter()
    local total = 0
    for y, row in ipairs(self.counts) do
        for x, count in ipairs(row) do
            if count > 0 then
                local w, h = self.xs[x + 1] - self.xs[x], self.ys[y + 1] - self.ys[y]
                if x == 1 or row[x - 1] == 0 then
                    total = total + h
                end
                if x == #row or row[x + 1] == 0 then
                    total = total + h
                end
                if y == 1 or self.counts[y - 1][x] == 0 then
                    total = total + w
                end
                if y == #self.counts or self.counts[y + 1][x] == 0 then
                    total = total + w
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return total
end
function Grid:empty()
    local best
    for left = 1, #self.xs - 1 do
        local blocked = {}
        for y = 1, #self.counts do
            blocked[y] = false
        end
        for right = left, #self.xs - 1 do
            for y = 1, #blocked do
                blocked[y] = blocked[y] or self.counts[y][right] > 0
            end
            local y = 1
            while y <= #blocked do
                if blocked[y] then
                    y = y + 1
                else
                    local start = y
                    while y <= #blocked and not blocked[y] do
                        y = y + 1
                    end
                    local r = {
                        x1 = self.xs[left],
                        y1 = self.ys[start],
                        x2 = self.xs[right + 1],
                        y2 = self.ys[y]
                    }
                    if
                        not best or area(r) > area(best) or
                            area(r) == area(best) and
                                (r.x1 < best.x1 or
                                    r.x1 == best.x1 and
                                        (r.y1 < best.y1 or
                                            r.y1 == best.y1 and r.x2 - r.x1 < best.x2 - best.x1))
                     then
                        best = r
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end
function Grid:holes()
    local result, seen = {}, {}
    for y, row in ipairs(self.counts) do
        seen[y] = {}
        for x = 1, #row do
            seen[y][x] = false
        end
    end
    for y, row in ipairs(self.counts) do
        for x, count in ipairs(row) do
            if count == 0 and not seen[y][x] then
                local queue, outside = {{x, y}}, false
                seen[y][x] = true
                local h = {
                    x1 = self.xs[x],
                    y1 = self.ys[y],
                    x2 = self.xs[x + 1],
                    y2 = self.ys[y + 1],
                    area = 0,
                    ax = self.xs[x],
                    ay = self.ys[y]
                }
                local i = 1
                while i <= #queue do
                    local xx, yy = queue[i][1], queue[i][2]
                    i = i + 1
                    if xx == 1 or yy == 1 or xx == #row or yy == #self.counts then
                        outside = true
                    end
                    h.area =
                        h.area + (self.xs[xx + 1] - self.xs[xx]) * (self.ys[yy + 1] - self.ys[yy])
                    h.x1, h.y1, h.x2, h.y2 =
                        math.min(h.x1, self.xs[xx]),
                        math.min(h.y1, self.ys[yy]),
                        math.max(h.x2, self.xs[xx + 1]),
                        math.max(h.y2, self.ys[yy + 1])
                    if self.ys[yy] < h.ay or self.ys[yy] == h.ay and self.xs[xx] < h.ax then
                        h.ax, h.ay = self.xs[xx], self.ys[yy]
                    end
                    for _, delta in ipairs({{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}}) do
                        local a, b = xx + delta[1], yy + delta[2]
                        if
                            a >= 1 and a <= #row and b >= 1 and b <= #self.counts and not seen[b][a] and
                                self.counts[b][a] == 0
                         then
                            seen[b][a] = true
                            queue[#queue + 1] = {a, b}
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not outside then
                    result[#result + 1] = h
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(
        result,
        function(a, b)
            return a.ay < b.ay or a.ay == b.ay and a.ax < b.ax
        end
    )
    return result
end
function Grid:pieces()
    local active, result = {}, {}
    for y, row in ipairs(self.counts) do
        local current, x = {}, 1
        while x <= #row do
            if row[x] == 0 then
                x = x + 1
            else
                local start = x
                while x <= #row and row[x] > 0 do
                    x = x + 1
                end
                local key = self.xs[start] .. ":" .. self.xs[x]
                local r =
                    active[key] or
                    {x1 = self.xs[start], y1 = self.ys[y], x2 = self.xs[x], y2 = self.ys[y + 1]}
                r.y2 = self.ys[y + 1]
                current[key] = r
            end
        end
        for key, r in pairs(active) do
            if not current[key] then
                result[#result + 1] = r
            end
        end
        active = current
    end
    for _, r in pairs(active) do
        result[#result + 1] = r
    end
    table.sort(
        result,
        function(a, b)
            return a.y1 < b.y1 or a.y1 == b.y1 and a.x1 < b.x1
        end
    )
    return result
end
local function names(list)
    local result = {}
    for _, r in ipairs(list) do
        result[#result + 1] = r.name
    end
    return #result > 0 and table.concat(result, " ") or "none"
end
local function nets(list)
    local result, seen = {}, {}
    for _, r in ipairs(list) do
        if not seen[r.name] then
            local group, i = {r}, 1
            seen[r.name] = true
            while i <= #group do
                for _, q in ipairs(list) do
                    if not seen[q.name] and connected(group[i], q) then
                        seen[q.name] = true
                        group[#group + 1] = q
                    end
                end
                i = i + 1
            end
            table.sort(
                group,
                function(a, b)
                    return a.name < b.name
                end
            )
            result[#result + 1] = group
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function spacing(list, s)
    local result = {}
    for i, a in ipairs(list) do
        for j = i + 1, #list do
            local b, r = list[j], compare(a, list[j])
            if r.kind == "corner" or r.kind == "separate" and r.gap < s then
                result[#result + 1] = {
                    a = a.name,
                    b = b.name,
                    gap = r.gap,
                    direction = r.kind == "corner" and "corner" or r.direction
                }
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(
        result,
        function(a, b)
            return a.gap < b.gap or a.gap == b.gap and (a.a < b.a or a.a == b.a and a.b < b.b)
        end
    )
    return result
end
local C = {rectangles = {}, rules = {}, history = {}, output = {}}
function C:emit(format, ...)
    self.output[#self.output + 1] = string.format(format, ...)
end
function C:fail(format, ...)
    error("error: " .. string.format(format, ...), 0)
end
function C:get(name)
    if not self.rectangles[name] then
        self:fail("unknown rectangle %s", name)
    end
    return self.rectangles[name]
end
function C:list(layer)
    local result = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(keys(self.rectangles)) do
        local r = self.rectangles[name]
        if not layer or r.layer == layer then
            result[#result + 1] = r
        end
    end
    return result
end
function C:require(layer)
    local list = self:list(layer)
    if #list == 0 then
        self:fail("no rectangles on %s", layer)
    end
    return list
end
function C:remember(line)
    self.history[#self.history + 1] = {rectangles = copy(self.rectangles), command = line}
end
function C:checkBounds(r)
    if
        math.abs(r.x1) > 10000 or math.abs(r.y1) > 10000 or math.abs(r.x2) > 10000 or
            math.abs(r.y2) > 10000
     then
        self:fail("out of bounds")
    end
end
function C:violationLines(list)
    for _, v in ipairs(list) do
        self:emit("%s %s gap %d %s", v.a, v.b, v.gap, v.direction)
    end
end
function C:density(layer, list, g, w)
    local r = bounds(list)
    local columns, rows = (r.x2 - r.x1 + w - 1) // w, (r.y2 - r.y1 + w - 1) // w
    if columns > 20 or rows > 20 then
        self:fail("too many windows")
    end
    local values, lowest, highest, lowX, lowY, highX, highY = {}, nil, nil, 0, 0, 0, 0
    for y = 0, rows - 1 do
        values[y] = {}
        for x = 0, columns - 1 do
            local tile = {
                x1 = r.x1 + x * w,
                y1 = r.y1 + y * w,
                x2 = r.x1 + (x + 1) * w,
                y2 = r.y1 + (y + 1) * w
            }
            local v = g:covered(1, tile)
            values[y][x] = v
            if lowest == nil or v < lowest then
                lowest, lowX, lowY = v, x, y
            end
            if highest == nil or v > highest then
                highest, highX, highY = v, x, y
            end
        end
    end
    self:emit("density %s window %d: %dx%d", layer, w, columns, rows)
    for y = rows - 1, 0, -1 do
        local parts = {}
        for x = 0, columns - 1 do
            parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(100 * values[y][x] // (w * w))
        end
        self:emit("%s", table.concat(parts, " "))
    end
    self:emit(
        "min %s%% at %s",
        decimal(100 * lowest, w * w),
        point(r.x1 + lowX * w, r.y1 + lowY * w)
    )
    self:emit(
        "max %s%% at %s",
        decimal(100 * highest, w * w),
        point(r.x1 + highX * w, r.y1 + highY * w)
    )
end
function C:check()
    if not next(self.rules) then
        self:fail("no rules")
    end
    local rules = {}
    for _, r in pairs(self.rules) do
        rules[#rules + 1] = r
    end
    table.sort(
        rules,
        function(a, b)
            return a.kind < b.kind or
                a.kind == b.kind and (a.inner < b.inner or a.inner == b.inner and a.outer < b.outer)
        end
    )
    local total = 0
    for _, r in ipairs(rules) do
        local list, lines = self:list(r.inner), {}
        if r.kind == "spacing" then
            for _, v in ipairs(spacing(list, r.value)) do
                lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s %s gap %d %s", v.a, v.b, v.gap, v.direction)
            end
        elseif r.kind == "width" then
            for _, q in ipairs(list) do
                local w = math.min(q.x2 - q.x1, q.y2 - q.y1)
                if w < r.value then
                    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s width %d", q.name, w)
                end
            end
        else
            local outer = self:list(r.outer)
            for _, q in ipairs(list) do
                local best
                for _, p in ipairs(outer) do
                    local value = minimum(margins(p, q))
                    best = best and math.max(best, value) or value
                end
                if not best then
                    lines[#lines + 1] = q.name .. " best margin none"
                elseif best < r.value then
                    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s best margin %d", q.name, best)
                end
            end
        end
        if r.kind == "enclose" then
            self:emit("enclose %s %s %d: %d violations", r.inner, r.outer, r.value, #lines)
        else
            self:emit("%s %s %d: %d violations", r.kind, r.inner, r.value, #lines)
        end
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
            self:emit("%s", line)
        end
        total = total + #lines
    end
    self:emit("check: %d violations in %d rules", total, #rules)
end
function C:execute(line)
    local args = words(line)
    local command = table.remove(args, 1)
    if command == "ADD" then
        if self.rectangles[args[1]] then
            self:fail("duplicate rectangle %s", args[1])
        end
        local r = {
            name = args[1],
            layer = args[2],
            x1 = tonumber(args[3]),
            y1 = tonumber(args[4]),
            x2 = tonumber(args[5]),
            y2 = tonumber(args[6])
        }
        if r.x1 >= r.x2 or r.y1 >= r.y2 then
            self:fail("invalid rectangle")
        end
        self:checkBounds(r)
        self:remember(line)
        self.rectangles[r.name] = r
        self:emit("added %s %s %s", r.name, r.layer, notation(r))
        return
    elseif
        command == "COPY" or command == "MOVE" or command == "RESIZE" or command == "SPLIT" or
            command == "LAYER" or
            command == "DELETE"
     then
        local original = self:get(args[1])
        local r = copy(original)
        if command == "COPY" then
            if self.rectangles[args[2]] then
                self:fail("duplicate rectangle %s", args[2])
            end
            r.name = args[2]
            local dx, dy = tonumber(args[3]), tonumber(args[4])
            r.x1, r.x2, r.y1, r.y2 = r.x1 + dx, r.x2 + dx, r.y1 + dy, r.y2 + dy
            self:checkBounds(r)
            self:remember(line)
            self.rectangles[r.name] = r
            self:emit("copied %s to %s %s", original.name, r.name, notation(r))
        elseif command == "MOVE" then
            local dx, dy = tonumber(args[2]), tonumber(args[3])
            r.x1, r.x2, r.y1, r.y2 = r.x1 + dx, r.x2 + dx, r.y1 + dy, r.y2 + dy
            self:checkBounds(r)
            self:remember(line)
            self.rectangles[r.name] = r
            self:emit("moved %s to %s", r.name, notation(r))
        elseif command == "RESIZE" then
            local w, h = tonumber(args[2]), tonumber(args[3])
            if w <= 0 or h <= 0 then
                self:fail("invalid size")
            end
            r.x2, r.y2 = r.x1 + w, r.y1 + h
            self:checkBounds(r)
            self:remember(line)
            self.rectangles[r.name] = r
            self:emit("resized %s to %s", r.name, notation(r))
        elseif command == "SPLIT" then
            if self.rectangles[args[4]] then
                self:fail("duplicate rectangle %s", args[4])
            end
            local pos = tonumber(args[3])
            if
                args[2] == "x" and (pos <= r.x1 or pos >= r.x2) or
                    args[2] == "y" and (pos <= r.y1 or pos >= r.y2)
             then
                self:fail("cut outside %s", r.name)
            end
            local q = copy(r)
            q.name = args[4]
            if args[2] == "x" then
                r.x2, q.x1 = pos, pos
            else
                r.y2, q.y1 = pos, pos
            end
            self:remember(line)
            self.rectangles[r.name], self.rectangles[q.name] = r, q
            self:emit(
                "split %s at %s=%d: %s %s, %s %s",
                r.name,
                args[2],
                pos,
                r.name,
                notation(r),
                q.name,
                notation(q)
            )
        elseif command == "LAYER" then
            if r.layer == args[2] then
                self:fail("already on %s", r.layer)
            end
            r.layer = args[2]
            self:remember(line)
            self.rectangles[r.name] = r
            self:emit("layer %s %s -> %s", r.name, original.layer, r.layer)
        else
            self:remember(line)
            self.rectangles[r.name] = nil
            self:emit("deleted %s", r.name)
        end
        return
    elseif command == "UNDO" then
        if #self.history == 0 then
            self:fail("nothing to undo")
        end
        local previous = table.remove(self.history)
        self.rectangles = previous.rectangles
        self:emit("undo: %s", previous.command)
        return
    elseif command == "LIST" then
        local list = self:list()
        self:emit("rectangles: %d", #list)
        for _, r in ipairs(list) do
            self:emit("%s %s %s %dx%d", r.name, r.layer, notation(r), r.x2 - r.x1, r.y2 - r.y1)
        end
        return
    elseif command == "INFO" then
        local r = self:get(args[1])
        self:emit(
            "%s %s %s %dx%d area %d",
            r.name,
            r.layer,
            notation(r),
            r.x2 - r.x1,
            r.y2 - r.y1,
            area(r)
        )
        for _, kind in ipairs({"overlap", "edge", "corner", "encloses", "enclosed by"}) do
            local selected = {}
            for _, q in ipairs(self:list()) do
                if q.name ~= r.name then
                    local relation = compare(r, q)
                    local matched = q.layer == r.layer and relation.kind == kind
                    if kind == "encloses" then
                        matched = encloses(r, q)
                    elseif kind == "enclosed by" then
                        matched = encloses(q, r)
                    end
                    if matched then
                        selected[#selected + 1] = q
                    end
                end
            end
            self:emit(
                "%s: %s",
                ({
                    overlap = "overlaps",
                    edge = "touches",
                    corner = "corners",
                    encloses = "encloses",
                    ["enclosed by"] = "enclosed by"
                })[kind],
                names(selected)
            )
        end
        return
    elseif command == "LAYERS" then
        local layers = {}
        for _, r in pairs(self.rectangles) do
            layers[r.layer] = true
        end
        local list = keys(layers)
        self:emit("layers: %d", #list)
        for _, layer in ipairs(list) do
            local rectangles = self:list(layer)
            self:emit(
                "%s: %d rectangles, area %d, nets %d",
                layer,
                #rectangles,
                makeGrid(rectangles):covered(1),
                #nets(rectangles)
            )
        end
        return
    elseif command == "OVERLAPS" then
        local list = args[1] and self:require(args[1]) or self:list()
        local overlaps = {}
        for i, a in ipairs(list) do
            for j = i + 1, #list do
                local b, r = list[j], compare(a, list[j])
                if a.layer == b.layer and r.kind == "overlap" then
                    overlaps[#overlaps + 1] = {a = a, b = b, r = r}
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(
            overlaps,
            function(a, b)
                return a.a.layer < b.a.layer or
                    a.a.layer == b.a.layer and
                        (a.a.name < b.a.name or a.a.name == b.a.name and a.b.name < b.b.name)
            end
        )
        if args[1] then
            self:emit("overlaps %s: %d", args[1], #overlaps)
        else
            self:emit("overlaps all layers: %d", #overlaps)
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(overlaps) do
            self:emit(
                "%s%s %s %s area %d",
                args[1] and "" or p.a.layer .. " ",
                p.a.name,
                p.b.name,
                notation(p.r),
                p.r.ox * p.r.oy
            )
        end
        return
    elseif
        command == "INTERSECT" or command == "ADJACENT" or command == "ENCLOSE" or command == "PATH"
     then
        local a = self:get(args[1])
        local b = self:get(args[2])
        if a.name == b.name then
            self:fail("same rectangle %s", a.name)
        end
        local r = compare(a, b)
        if command == "INTERSECT" then
            if r.kind == "overlap" then
                self:emit("intersect %s %s: %s area %d", a.name, b.name, notation(r), r.ox * r.oy)
            elseif r.kind == "edge" then
                self:emit(
                    "intersect %s %s: segment %s length %d",
                    a.name,
                    b.name,
                    notation(r),
                    r.ox + r.oy
                )
            elseif r.kind == "corner" then
                self:emit("intersect %s %s: point %s", a.name, b.name, point(r.x1, r.y1))
            else
                self:emit("intersect %s %s: none, gap %d", a.name, b.name, r.gap)
            end
        elseif command == "ADJACENT" then
            if r.kind == "overlap" then
                self:emit("adjacent %s %s: overlapping", a.name, b.name)
            elseif r.kind == "corner" then
                self:emit("adjacent %s %s: corner only at %s", a.name, b.name, point(r.x1, r.y1))
            elseif r.kind == "edge" then
                local direction =
                    r.ox == 0 and (a.x2 == r.x1 and "west" or "east") or
                    (a.y2 == r.y1 and "south" or "north")
                self:emit(
                    "adjacent %s %s: %s is %s of %s, edge %s, length %d",
                    a.name,
                    b.name,
                    a.name,
                    direction,
                    b.name,
                    notation(r),
                    r.ox + r.oy
                )
            else
                self:emit("adjacent %s %s: not adjacent", a.name, b.name)
            end
        elseif command == "ENCLOSE" then
            local m = margins(a, b)
            local text = string.format("margins left %d bottom %d right %d top %d", table.unpack(m))
            if minimum(m) >= 0 then
                self:emit("enclose %s %s: yes, %s, min %d", a.name, b.name, text, minimum(m))
            else
                self:emit("enclose %s %s: no, %s", a.name, b.name, text)
            end
        else
            if a.layer ~= b.layer then
                self:fail("different layers")
            end
            local queue, parents, i = {a}, {[a.name] = false}, 1
            while i <= #queue do
                for _, q in ipairs(self:list(a.layer)) do
                    if parents[q.name] == nil and connected(queue[i], q) then
                        parents[q.name] = queue[i].name
                        queue[#queue + 1] = q
                    end
                end
                i = i + 1
            end
            if parents[b.name] == nil then
                self:emit("path %s %s: none", a.name, b.name)
            else
                local path, name = {}, b.name
                while name do
                    table.insert(path, 1, name)
                    name = parents[name]
                end
                self:emit(
                    "path %s %s: %s (%d steps)",
                    a.name,
                    b.name,
                    table.concat(path, " -> "),
                    #path - 1
                )
            end
        end
        return
    elseif command == "AT" then
        local x, y, parts = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2]), {}
        for _, r in ipairs(self:list()) do
            if x >= r.x1 and x <= r.x2 and y >= r.y1 and y <= r.y2 then
                local vertical, horizontal = x == r.x1 or x == r.x2, y == r.y1 or y == r.y2
                parts[#parts + 1] =
                    r.name ..
                    " " ..
                        r.layer ..
                            " " ..
                                (vertical and horizontal and "corner" or
                                    (vertical or horizontal) and "edge" or
                                    "inside")
            end
        end
        self:emit("at %s: %s", point(x, y), #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ", ") or "none")
        return
    elseif command == "NEAREST" then
        local r = self:get(args[1])
        local nearest, gap
        for _, q in ipairs(self:list(r.layer)) do
            if q.name ~= r.name then
                local value = compare(r, q).gap
                if not nearest or value < gap then
                    nearest, gap = q, value
                end
            end
        end
        if nearest then
            self:emit("nearest %s: %s gap %d", r.name, nearest.name, gap)
        else
            self:emit("nearest %s: none", r.name)
        end
        return
    elseif command == "RULE" then
        local r = {kind = args[1]:lower(), inner = args[2], outer = ""}
        if r.kind == "enclose" then
            r.outer, r.value = args[3], tonumber(args[4])
            if r.inner == r.outer then
                self:fail("same layer %s", r.inner)
            end
        else
            r.value = tonumber(args[3])
        end
        self.rules[r.kind .. ":" .. r.inner .. ":" .. r.outer] = r
        if r.kind == "enclose" then
            self:emit("rule enclose %s %s %d", r.inner, r.outer, r.value)
        else
            self:emit("rule %s %s %d", r.kind, r.inner, r.value)
        end
        return
    elseif command == "CHECK" then
        self:check()
        return
    end
    local layer = command == "COVER" and args[2] or args[1]
    local list = self:require(layer)
    local g = makeGrid(list)
    if command == "AREA" then
        self:emit("area %s: %d", layer, g:covered(1))
    elseif command == "COVER" then
        local k = tonumber(args[1])
        self:emit("cover %s >= %d: %d", layer, k, g:covered(k))
    elseif command == "PERIMETER" then
        self:emit("perimeter %s: %d", layer, g:perimeter())
    elseif command == "NETS" then
        local groups = nets(list)
        self:emit("nets %s: %d", layer, #groups)
        for i, group in ipairs(groups) do
            self:emit("net %d: %s area %d", i, names(group), makeGrid(group):covered(1))
        end
    elseif command == "DRC" then
        local s = tonumber(args[2])
        local violations = spacing(list, s)
        self:emit("drc %s spacing %d: %d violations", layer, s, #violations)
        self:violationLines(violations)
    elseif command == "BBOX" then
        local r = bounds(list)
        self:emit(
            "bbox %s: %s %dx%d, %d rectangles, density %s%%",
            layer,
            notation(r),
            r.x2 - r.x1,
            r.y2 - r.y1,
            #list,
            decimal(100 * g:covered(1), area(r))
        )
    elseif command == "DENSITY" then
        self:density(layer, list, g, tonumber(args[2]))
    elseif command == "RENDER" then
        local r = {
            x1 = tonumber(args[2]),
            y1 = tonumber(args[3]),
            x2 = tonumber(args[4]),
            y2 = tonumber(args[5])
        }
        if r.x1 >= r.x2 or r.y1 >= r.y2 then
            self:fail("invalid window")
        end
        if r.x2 - r.x1 > 60 or r.y2 - r.y1 > 40 then
            self:fail("window too large")
        end
        self:emit("render %s %s", layer, notation(r))
        for y = r.y2 - 1, r.y1, -1 do
            local row = {}
            for x = r.x1, r.x2 - 1 do
                local count = 0
                for _, q in ipairs(list) do
                    if x >= q.x1 and x < q.x2 and y >= q.y1 and y < q.y2 then
                        count = count + 1
                    end
                end
                row[#row + 1] = count == 0 and "." or count >= 10 and "*" or tostring(count)
            end
            self:emit("%s", table.concat(row))
        end
    elseif command == "EMPTY" then
        local r = g:empty()
        if r then
            self:emit("empty %s: %s area %d", layer, notation(r), area(r))
        else
            self:emit("empty %s: none", layer)
        end
    elseif command == "HOLES" then
        local holes = g:holes()
        self:emit("holes %s: %d", layer, #holes)
        for i, h in ipairs(holes) do
            self:emit("hole %d: area %d, bbox %s", i, h.area, notation(h))
        end
    elseif command == "MERGE" then
        local pieces = g:pieces()
        self:emit("merge %s: %d pieces", layer, #pieces)
        for _, r in ipairs(pieces) do
            self:emit("%s", notation(r))
        end
    end
end
local count = tonumber(io.read("*l"))
for _ = 1, count do
    local ok, message =
        pcall(
        function()
            C:execute(io.read("*l"))
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        C:emit("%s", message)
    end
end
if #C.output > 0 then
    io.write(table.concat(C.output, "\n"), "\n")
end
